name: janusx
description: CLI 工作区管理器 - 统一管理多个 AI 编程助手
author: Tree

scripts.dev: npm run build:note-tools && npm run build:llm-core && electron-vite dev --outDir .cache --entry scripts/dev-entry.mjs
scripts.build: npm run build:note-tools && npm run build:llm-core && electron-vite build
scripts.build:check: npm run build:note-tools && npm run build:llm-core && electron-vite build --outDir artifacts/build-check
scripts.build:plugin-sdk: npm run build:note-tools && npm run build --workspace=@janusx/plugin-sdk
scripts.plugins:create: npm run build:plugin-sdk && node packages/plugin-sdk/tools/cli.mjs init
scripts.plugins:distribution:check: npm run plugins:distribution:test:tools && vitest run tests/unit/plugin-distribution.test.ts tests/unit/plugin-catalog.test.ts tests/unit/plugin-configuration-drafts.test.ts
scripts.plugins:check: npm run plugins:check:platform && npm run plugins:test
scripts.plugins:check:platform: npm run build:plugin-sdk && node scripts/probe-plugin-background.mjs && node packages/plugin-sdk/tools/cli.mjs contract && node scripts/verify-plugin-scaffold.mjs
scripts.plugins:test: vitest run tests/unit/plugin-sdk.test.ts tests/unit/plugin-tools.test.ts tests/unit/plugin-runtime.test.ts tests/unit/plugin-surfaces.test.ts tests/unit/plugin-documents.test.ts tests/unit/plugin-document-editing.test.ts tests/unit/plugin-configuration.test.ts tests/unit/plugin-background.test.ts tests/unit/plugin-agent-services.test.ts tests/unit/plugin-skills.test.ts tests/unit/plugin-workflows.test.ts tests/unit/plugin-context.test.ts tests/unit/plugin-windows.test.ts tests/unit/plugin-themes.test.ts tests/unit/plugin-directories.test.ts tests/unit/plugin-instances.test.ts tests/unit/plugin-models.test.ts tests/unit/plugin-network-transport.test.ts tests/unit/extension-commands.test.ts
scripts.theme:check: npm run theme:css -- --check && npm run theme:audit -- --check
scripts.i18n: npm run i18n:extract && npm run i18n:types && npm run i18n:check
scripts.verify: npm run theme:check && npm run plugins:check:platform && npm run plugins:distribution:test:tools && npm run plugins:blueprint:check && npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:llm-core && npm run build:llm-core && npm run test:unit -- --run && npm run test:llm-core && npm run typecheck:strict-unused && npm run build:app && npm run check:package-boundary && npm run exclusions:check && npm run i18n:check && npm run check:notes && npm run lint && npm run test:e2e:desktop
scripts.verify:quick: npm run theme:check && npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:llm-core && npm run i18n:check && npm run lint && npm run test:unit:fast
scripts.verify:local: npm run verify && npm run check:skills-sync
scripts.package:prepare: npm run prepackage && npm run build && npm run check:package-boundary && npm run exclusions:sync
scripts.package:win: npm run package:win:build && npm run check:portable-runtime
scripts.package:win:stage: npm run package:win:build && npm run stage:win
scripts.package:mac: npm run prepackage && npm run build && npm run check:package-boundary && electron-builder --mac
scripts.package:linux: npm run prepackage && npm run build && npm run check:package-boundary && electron-builder --linux
scripts.plugins:blueprint:verify: npm run build:plugin-sdk && npm run build:llm-core && node scripts/plugins/verify-blueprint-build.mjs
scripts.test:blueprint:local: npm run build:plugin-sdk && npm run build:llm-core && playwright test --config playwright.blueprint-local.config.ts --workers=1
